Medium-length, wavy ash blonde hair with soft, airy curls and wispy bangs. Large, round, expressive eyes in a bright sky blue shade. Apparent age of a young adolescent with a cheerful expression. Petite, slender build. A navy blue and white sailor-style outfit with a short pleated skirt. Features a small ribbon in the hair and a youthful, energetic posture.
